title: 3rd Party � Executive Assistant � Claim Rejected � Customer Must Submit
goal: Validates that when an Executive Assistant attempts to submit a flight disruption claim on behalf of a passenger, the system rejects the submission similarly to a Travel Agency.

checkpoints.step: Validates that when an Executive Assistant attempts to submit a flight disruption claim on behalf of a passenger, the system rejects the submission similarly to a Travel Agency.
Third-party caller type: Executive Assistant
Given the user opens the agentic chatbot
Then the chatbot displays greeting (GLOB-01)
Then user selects English
Then chatbot asks "How can I help you today?"
checkpoints.expected: How can I help you today?

checkpoints.step: And the user says "I'm an executive assistant filing a flight disruption claim on behalf of my executive"
checkpoints.expected: I'm an executive assistant filing a flight disruption claim on behalf of my executive

checkpoints.step: When the chatbot identifies flight disruption intent
Then the chatbot checks: Is this a third-party submission? ? YES
Then the chatbot identifies third-party type ? Executive Assistant / Travel Agency
Then the chatbot responds advising that the customer must submit the claim themselves.
Then the chatbot offers: "Is there anything I can help you with?"
checkpoints.expected: Is there anything I can help you with?

checkpoints.step: And the user selects "No"
Then the chatbot responds "Thank you for choosing Air Canada."
checkpoints.expected: Thank you for choosing Air Canada.

checkpoints.step: Given the system correctly identifies the third-party type as "Executive Assistant" which is the same category as Travel Agency
Then the system should immediately reject the submission advising the customer must file themselves
And no case should be created in Claims Dashboard
And no manual handoff should occur
And the flow should end
And when searching Claims Dashboard no entry should exist for this Executive Assistant submission
Given the Executive Assistant submission was hard rejected per policy as same category as Travel Agency
Then no payment flow should be triggered
And no case should exist in Claims Dashboard
And no compensation record should have been created
And no batch file should have been dispatched
And no country of residence should have been asked
And no IDV should have been triggered
And no CyberSource fraud screening should have been triggered
